Scale: Avoid querying GitHub on every runner tick
Functional: Stop polling a human merge after 24 hours
Not done: When the work is done, the runner ends and makes no recurring GitHub calls.
Plan gap: Wire the stop continuation and summary callbacks
Standard: Replacing behaviour deletes the old path, its tests and its docs in the same change
Test: After one approval, every part becomes ready for a person to merge
Test: The folder of every merged item that holds no local changes is removed
Test: When the work is done, the runner ends and makes no recurring GitHub calls.
Test: CI and older-release repos do not start background work
Standard: Tests own and clean up every process they start, even after a crash
Follow-up: Clean merged worktrees in repos with submodules

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 4
Raise: Data loss
Case: normal use - a coordinator follows the guide to change a repo's test or runner settings.
The earlier issue remains: this prototype instruction says to set the test command and checks before starting a settings fix for `sample_data`. The guide also tells the coordinator to set runner labels directly at lines 459–462 and to set `fast_test` through a fix at line 1618, without requiring the file in that fix's Done-when. If the coordinator edits `forge.toml` in such a fix while its automatically started builder runs, `worker.py:467–472` restores the file and discards the edit when Done-when omits `forge.toml`. The guide also retains manual build-and-close instructions for dependency fixes at lines 1761–1779. This leaves the old path beside the replacement, contrary to the standard: “Replacing behaviour deletes the old path, its tests and its docs in the same change.”
findings.title: Standard: Replacing behaviour deletes the old path, its tests and its docs in the same change

stop.question:
Approved work keeps moving to merge without reminders: A background runner moves approved work to merge is stuck. It should deliver: Wake and start of the runner, automatic part and fix starts, builds through `forge land` with no chat, the land lock, polling of human merges, cleanup, the end of the runner, the stub seam for STOPS, all guide text
Two rounds in a row left the open P0 standard: replacing behaviour deletes the old path, its tests and its docs in the same change in src/forge/templates/skill.md.
The worker tried: Isolate runner in tests, enforce install-time scope cutoff, block test wakes, and finish prototype guide updates.
Choose one: switch this item to Claude; keep Antigravity for one more round; or narrow or split it.
stop.reason: Owner chose split: the guide lines that tell the coordinator to edit forge.toml in a settings fix without naming it (skill.md ~1257 sample_data, ~459-462 runner labels, ~1618 fast_test) become their own small fix that merges before v1.2.50
